name: We Buy Cars Holdings Limited
summary: We Buy Cars Holdings Limited engages in buying, distributing, and retailing pre-owned motor vehicles in South Africa. It is involved in the sales of car finance, insurance, and other ancillary products. The company also offers car protection, including car insurance, car tracking, warranty cover, service plans, scratch and dent cover, and tyre and rim cover services; and credit shortfall cover and credit protection plan services. In addition, it engages in the operation of car supermarket; and owns and rents warehouses. It sells its products through its digital platforms.
